title: Simple Beanie
description: A straightforward hat pattern that focuses on fit, ribbing, and clean finishing.
expectationText: A reliable first hat that helps you practice measuring head fit, repeating rows consistently, and assembling a wearable project neatly.

steps.title: Chain the height
steps.instruction: Chain the number of stitches needed for the beanie height, not the head circumference.

steps.title: Row 1
steps.instruction: Work across the chain and establish the edge of the ribbing panel.

steps.title: Build the ribbing
steps.instruction: Work back loop only rows until the panel wraps comfortably around the head.

steps.title: Join the seam
steps.instruction: Join the short ends together so the panel becomes a tube.

steps.title: Close the crown
steps.instruction: Gather the top edge closed with yarn, pull tight, and secure it well.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Turn the hat right side out and weave in the final ends.
